subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the famous Tawang monastery located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arunachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tawang Monastery is the largest monastery in India and is located in Arunachal Pradesh.__
 
• It is the second-largest monastery in the world after Potala Palac
